name: Tasks
description: Checkbox lines with todo.txt-style tokens: due:2026-10-01, start:, rec:monthly, until:, times:, !high, @person, #tag. Each token is a chip that opens its own editor; ⌘. opens a task's fields. Show tasks and ::tasks list them from across your notes, and ⌘⇧. adds one the way you'd say it. Ticking a repeating task logs it in today's daily note.

files:read.why: List tasks from every note in the Tasks view and ::tasks lists

files:write.why: Tick tasks and change their details from the Tasks view and ::tasks lists

editor.why: Draw tasks as checkboxes and chips in notes, and complete their tokens

commands.title: Add a due date to this task
Task fields: priority, due, repeat, person, tags

embeds.title: Task list
embeds.description: Tasks (- [ ] lines) from across your notes, gathered live and grouped by note, due date, priority, tag or person. Tick one here and it's ticked in its note; click a chip to change it.

folder.description: Only notes in this folder, like Projects

tag.description: Only tasks with this tag (and the tags under it), like work

assignee.label: Person
assignee.description: Only this person's tasks, like jane

limit.description: At most this many, then Show more

tasks.chips.description: Show a task's tokens as chips ("Tomorrow", "Monthly", "High") on lines the cursor isn't on.

tasks.inbox.description: The note quick-add (⌘⇧.) puts tasks in, by name, like Inbox. Empty: today's daily note, Journal/YYYY-MM-DD.

tasks.completionLog.description: Where ticking a repeating task is recorded. daily: it moves on to its next date, and a line goes under ## Done in today's daily note. inline: a ticked copy stays in its note, with the next one below it (as v1 did). none: it moves on, recorded only in history.

tasks.logPlainTasks.description: Log tasks that don't repeat in today's daily note too, when they're ticked (they're already ticked with done: in their own note).
